samples.description: A location-based game using GPS positioning, real-world map rendering, and route navigation.
An interactive world map with terrain, imagery, and vector layers. Good starting point for exploring the SDK.
Route calculation and turn-by-turn navigation using the Mapbox Directions API.
Address search and coordinate lookup using the Mapbox Geocoding API.
High-performance map rendering using the Components Module with merged building, road, and area meshes.
Detailed 3D landmark buildings with automatic OSM building suppression using the Components Module.
Detailed 3D landmark buildings with automatic OSM building suppression using the Vector Module.
